1. Case overview

Summary. Seven plans compare six NeoArc (DMAT) modulation variants with one VMAT reference. Saved comparative scores range from 6.318 to 8.012 out of 10; delivery durations range from 39.8 to 134.7 seconds. Individual target and organ-at-risk endpoints are shown alongside the aggregate score.

Clinical background and rationale. This prostate and nodal simultaneous integrated boost (SIB) case compares plans delivered in 28 fractions. The saved prescription assigns 70 Gy to PTV70 and CTV, and 50.4 Gy to PTV50.4 and CTV Nodal. The comparison examines target coverage at both dose levels, organ-at-risk dose and delivery duration under the recorded planning setup.

Plan generation. NeoArc (DMAT) plan generated for: Accela. Experiment 1: 10FFF, 2 arcs; modulation -2, -1, 0, +1, +2, +3. Reference setup: VMAT: 10FFF, 2 arcs.

Goal setup. 31–35 provided goals per NeoArc (DMAT) plan. Goal thresholds and priorities are listed in the planning tables; derived and supporting objectives are separate. Example from DA264: Urethra D0.03 cm3 ≤ 73.50 Gy (P1.1). Comparative scoring uses the saved custom scorecard, “Prostate+LNs 50.4/70Gy”, with 24 scored endpoints covering target dose and coverage, rectum, bladder, femoral heads, small bowel, sigmoid, penile bulb, urethra and dose-control rings. Saved thresholds, score curves and achieved values are retained in Scorecard details.

Comparison methods. Compared the dose colorwash, DVHs, quality–time graph and individual endpoint–time graphs. Dose normalization factors: 1. NeoArc (DMAT): Matched delivery metrics; VMAT: RT Plan control-point estimate. Durations do not represent total room time.

2. Dose colorwash

Compare target coverage and dose spread at the same slice.

Scroll over a dose image to change slices. Use the slider or arrow keys as an alternative. Dragging is disabled.

Dose viewer loads when visible.
10 GySIB 50.4 GySIB 70 Gy76.5 Gy

Colorwash sampling details

Every dose is evaluated on DA264’s patient-coordinate dose grid before CT slices are sampled every 5 mm from its isocenter. Native grids that differ are trilinearly resampled. The in-plane display and superior–inferior slice range are restricted to the selected reference plan’s 40% prescription-dose bounding volume plus 50 mm in every direction; CT slices outside that range are not embedded. Each colorwash has a slim slice slider beneath it; moving any slider advances every plan synchronously. The compact zoom buttons, pointer drag, and reset remain synchronized and persist while changing slices. Mouse-wheel scrolling continues to move the report page. All plans use the confirmed 10–76.5 Gy color scale.

Scoring method

Imported or selected score curves, weights, and thresholds are retained. The traffic-light summary classifies evaluated values as goal, variation, or deviation; missing or unmapped endpoints contribute zero points. Native technical-report compliance scores remain separate.
